hub.title: Let's get started
hub.subtitle: Your personalized training plan awaits
hub.allDone: All set! Your training plan is ready.

aboutYou.title: About You
aboutYou.description: Tell us about your goals, basic details, and training needs so we can build a plan that fits you.

trainingPreferences.title: Training Preferences
trainingPreferences.description: How often, how hard, and what style of training works for you.

gymEquipment.title: Gym & Equipment
gymEquipment.description: Where you train and what equipment you have access to.

hub.prefilled: We've filled in what we already know from your fitness profile.
hub.missingPlan: Your setup is complete, but there's no active training plan. Create it from your saved answers.
hub.why: Three short sections — about you, how you train, and your equipment — so your plan and nutrition targets fit you. It takes about 3 minutes, and your Home setup answers are already filled in.

goal.title: What's your primary goal?
goal.subtitle: This helps us recommend the right exercises and sets for you.

lose_weight.title: Lose Weight
lose_weight.description: Higher-rep, lighter-weight training focused on fat loss, endurance, and muscle tone.

build_muscle.title: Build Muscle
build_muscle.description: Moderate-rep, heavy-weight training focused on muscle growth, strength, and definition.

stay_healthy.title: Stay Healthy
stay_healthy.description: Perform a variety of exercises to improve health, strength and consistency.

obstacle.title: What is stopping you from achieving this goal?

gender.title: Choose your gender
gender.subtitle: Used for your training plan and to estimate your daily calories and protein.

age.title: What's your age?
age.hint: We use your age and BMI to set the right intensity, for example gentler, low-impact moves from age 50.

heightWeight.title: Height & weight
heightWeight.bmiSuffix: , and we use it to help tailor your fitness plan to you.

comingSoon: This step will be available in a future update.

experience.title: What's your training experience?
experience.subtitle: This helps us recommend the right exercises and weights for you.

no_experience.title: Beginner
no_experience.description: New to training. Not familiar with common exercises or training equipment. Focus on building a solid foundation.

beginner.title: Basic
beginner.description: Some training experience (<1 year). Familiar with basic exercises but still learning proper form and technique.

intermediate.title: Intermediate
intermediate.description: 1–2 years of training experience. Good understanding of exercises and proper form. Ready for more advanced methods.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: 3 years or more of consistent training experience. Achieved significant strength and muscle development.

daysPerWeek.title: How many days per week do you train?
daysPerWeek.subtitle: Setting a realistic goal will help you stay motivated and track your progress.

excludeMuscles.title: Do you want to exclude any muscles?
excludeMuscles.subtitle: You can tell us which muscles to avoid when building your workout plan.

no.title: No
no.description: We'll build your plan without excluding any muscles.

yes.title: Yes
yes.description: Choose up to 4 muscles to avoid.

excludeMusclesSelect.title: Which muscles would you like to exclude?
excludeMusclesSelect.subtitle: Select up to 4

prioritizeMuscles.title: Do you want to focus on specific muscles?
prioritizeMuscles.subtitle: You can tell us which muscles to prioritize in your workout plan.

no.title: No
no.description: We'll let AI balance your plan without prioritizing specific muscles.

yes.title: Yes
yes.description: Choose up to 3 muscles to prioritize.

prioritizeMusclesSelect.title: Which muscles would you like to prioritize?
prioritizeMusclesSelect.subtitle: Select up to 3

variety.title: How much exercise variety do you want?
variety.subtitle: After each workout, AI adjusts the exercises in your next session based on your progress and goals. You can change this later.

fixed.title: Fixed
fixed.description: Keeps the same exercises across workouts with no automatic changes.

balanced.title: Balanced
balanced.description: Moderate variability to balance progress and variety.

dynamic.title: Dynamic
dynamic.description: Changes exercises more often to keep workouts fresh and challenging.

duration.title: How long are your workouts?
duration.subtitle: Pick an average duration for each session. You can change this later.
duration.recommendedBody: For steady progress, we recommend 45-60 minutes per session.

muscleBlocked.excluded: Already excluded — remove it from Excluded Muscles first.
muscleBlocked.prioritized: Already a focus muscle — remove it from Focused Muscles first.

large_gym.title: Large Gym
large_gym.description: Full fitness clubs such as Anytime, Fitness First, Gold's, Planet Fitness, etc.

garage_gym.title: Garage Gym
garage_gym.description: Barbells, squat rack, dumbbells and more.

equipment.title: What equipment do you have access to?
equipment.subtitle: You can change it later.

search.emptyFiltered: Nothing to show with these filters.

equipment.largeGymHint: We’ve preselected common equipment found in large gyms. Deselect anything your regular gym doesn’t have.

addCardio.title: Add cardio to your plan?
addCardio.subtitle: We can include cardio in your generated training plan. You can change this later.

chooseCardio.title: Choose your cardio
chooseCardio.subtitle: Pick your go-to cardio exercises, and we'll add them to your workouts where they fit.

planReady.headline: Your AI-powered coach is ready!
planReady.saveError: Something went wrong saving your plan. Please try again.

activityLevel.title: How active is your daily life?
activityLevel.hint: Think about a typical day outside your workouts. We use this to estimate how many calories you burn.

low.title: Low Activity
low.description: Mostly sedentary · usually under about {{max}} steps a day

moderate.title: Moderate Activity
moderate.description: Regular daily walking · about {{min}}–{{max}} steps a day

high.title: High Activity
high.description: Highly active lifestyle · often above about {{min}} steps a day

recommended.title: Your training structure
recommended.reason: Recommended based on your {{days}}-day weekly schedule, {{experience}} training experience and {{goal}} goal.
recommended.consecutive: Your training days run back to back, so each day trains different muscles to give the rest time to recover.
recommended.limited: With your available equipment, this structure keeps every session full of exercises you can actually do.
recommended.short: Short sessions work best with fewer, broader workouts.
